inputs.resume_text:
Harsh Agarwal
PGP 2025-27, Indian Institute of Management Lucknow | harsh.agarwal@iiml.ac.in

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS
PGP, IIM Lucknow, 2025-27, CGPA 6.9/10
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College of Commerce, Mumbai, 2020, 71%

WORK EXPERIENCE (36 months)
Agarwal Textiles Pvt Ltd (family business), Surat | Business Development Lead | Jul 2021 - Jun 2024
- Opened 3 new export markets (Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, UAE) for synthetic sarees; export share grew from 4% to 19% of revenue in 2 years
- Moved 140 retail dealers from paper orders to a WhatsApp-based ordering catalogue; order processing time dropped from 3 days to same day
- Negotiated yarn contracts worth INR 22 crore a year with 2 Reliance-linked suppliers
Agarwal Textiles, Trainee | Jul 2020 - Jun 2021

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Asian Paints | Sales and Distribution Intern, Nagpur | Apr - Jun 2026
- Mapped 210 painters and 64 dealers in 3 tier-3 towns; designed a painter-loyalty referral scheme that brought 31 new painters into the program in 6 weeks
- Identified that 40% of dealer stock-outs were in 12 fast-moving SKUs and proposed a weekly top-up route; pilot reduced lost orders by an estimated INR 9 lakh a month
- Received PPO

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Coordinator, Sales and Marketing Club (Markathon), IIM Lucknow
- Captain, college cricket team, NMCC (2018-19)

plan.warmup_question: What have you been learning recently at IIM Lucknow?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your career so far, including the experience that led you to IIM Lucknow.

slots.core_question: At Asian Paints, you designed a painter-referral scheme. What were you trying to change in the sales process?
slots.intent_private: Needs the customer or channel problem, Harsh's personal actions in designing the scheme, how the 31-painter increase was measured, and what he would do differently now.
likely_probes: What part of the scheme did you personally design?
What would you change if you ran the six-week pilot again?
How was the 31-painter increase measured?

slots.core_question: How did opening three export markets at Agarwal Textiles come about?
slots.intent_private: Needs the market-selection logic, Harsh's specific business-development actions, the comparison behind export share rising from 4% to 19%, and the stakeholders involved.
likely_probes: What did you personally do to win those markets?
Which market did you prioritise first?
What was the comparison behind the increase from 4% to 19%?

slots.core_question: As captain of the NMCC cricket team, what was the hardest team situation you had to handle?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific team challenge, Harsh's personal leadership response, the people decision he made, and evidence that the situation improved.
likely_probes: What did you personally do when the situation became difficult?
What leadership approach did you choose for the team?
How did you know the situation had improved?

slots.core_question: Tell me about the most difficult negotiation you handled for the yarn contracts at Agarwal Textiles.
slots.intent_private: Needs the negotiation context, Harsh's personal role, the key trade-off with the suppliers, and how the INR 22 crore annual value was determined.
likely_probes: What did you personally own in that negotiation?
Which trade-off mattered most in the agreement?
How was the INR 22 crore annual value calculated?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritises the completed Asian Paints internship, quantified market-development results from Agarwal Textiles, negotiation scope, and the required extracurricular leadership topic for a finals back-your-resume round. The resume is commercially strong and distinctive, though the family-business claims warrant checking Harsh's personal decisions and the basis for the reported results.
